description: Defines the 'Services' class and related nested classes for managing broadcast services, including scanning, service info, and DVB table handling.

classes.name: Services
classes.description: Manages broadcast services, scanning, and DVB table processing.

classes.name: Services::Sink
classes.description: Handles tuner notifications such as activation, deactivation, and state changes.

classes.name: Services::Parser
classes.description: Parses DVB SDT sections and loads service information.

methods.name: Services::Scan
methods.description: Starts or stops scanning for services.

methods.name: Services::Id
methods.description: Retrieves service information by service ID.

methods.name: Services::List
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the list of services.

methods.name: Services::Load
methods.description: Loads service data from DVB SDT table.
